newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH buys French perfume maker Sephora.
newsitem.headline: LVMH buys French perfume maker Sephora.

text.p: LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton said Wednesday it bought Sephora, France's leading perfume and beauty products retailer, for 1.6 billion francs ($260.8 million).
"With this acquisition, LVMH becomes the world's leading distributor of perfumes and beauty products," LVMH said.
LVMH earlier this year expanded its presence in retailing with the $2.6 billion acquisition of San Francisco-based Duty Free Shoppers.
Sephora has 54 stores, including a new 14,000 square foot shop on the Champs-Elysees.
